start: Member with past Bench press sessions (3 sets of 8 at 60 kg, rep range 8-10), opens today's workout plan in the coach

steps.action: Open today's workout plan (the coach's plan card or the Workout tab)
user_sees: Bench press 'Target: 60 kg' with the note 'Solid 60 kg × 8 last time — same weight, push for 9 today.'
must_not: A target worked out from a set logged earlier today
A weight that is not on the plate step (2.5 kg)

steps.action: Log 3 sets of 10 at 60 kg, then open the plan again the next day
user_sees: 'You hit 10, 10, 10 at 60 kg — time to move up.'
must_not: The weight goes up when only the top set reached 10

start: Member adds an exercise never done before (a barbell, a bodyweight and a dumbbell exercise)

steps.action: Open today's plan with a new barbell exercise
user_sees: 'First time on <exercise> — start with the empty bar (20 kg) and own every rep.'
must_not: A target above 20 kg with no history

steps.action: Look at a new bodyweight and a new dumbbell exercise
user_sees: 'First time on <exercise> — bodyweight only today, focus on clean controlled reps.'
'First time on <exercise> — starting light at 7.5 kg to groove the movement.'
must_not: A weight added to a bodyweight exercise

start: Member whose last two Squat sessions were under the rep range (6 then 5 reps at 100 kg, range 8-10), and one past session saved with no working sets

user_sees: 'Reps have slipped under 8 two sessions in a row — resetting to 90 kg to build back up stronger.'
must_not: A deload target above the last weight
A deload below one plate step

steps.action: Look at an exercise whose only past session has no working sets
user_sees: The first-time note and start weight
must_not: A crash or a target of 0 kg for a barbell exercise

start: Member who already finished today's workout, and one stuck at 60 kg for three sessions

steps.action: Finish today's Bench press, then open today's plan again the same day
user_sees: The same target as this morning
must_not: The target changes during the day because of today's own sets

steps.action: With three sessions at 60 kg and reps not climbing, open the plan
user_sees: 'You've been stuck at 60 kg for three weeks — deloading to 54 kg to break the plateau.'
must_not: A deload when the reps went up
'three weeks' said when the three sessions fell in fewer days (seen in passing)
